subject: About the D form amino amber force field

messages.author: Yeng-Tseng Wang
messages.body:
Dear all,
Could you tell me how to get them?
Thanks
YT

messages.author: Carlos Simmerling
messages.body:
It is the same force field.
For an example of using it see
Experimental and Computational Analysis of Protein Stabilization by
Gly-to-D-Ala Substitution: A Convolution of Native State and Unfolded State
Effects
Zou, Junjie; Song, Benben; Simmerling, Carlos; Raleigh, Daniel, Journal of
the American Chemical Society, 2016, 138 (48), 15682–15689
DOI: 10.1021/jacs.6b09511
